quarterly_data.quarter: onsemi press release: onsemi and Sungrow Advance Utility-Scale Energy Storage (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Design win (onsemi's word): Sungrow has adopted onsemi's latest EliteSiC silicon carbide hybrid power module technology for its PowerTitan 3.0 utility-scale battery energy storage (BESS) platform, which incorporates onsemi's high-density power integrated modules (PIMs) optimized for three-level inverter architectures. Versus the previous-generation platform the new architecture improves inverter-level efficiency by 0.4%, supports power conversion units rated up to 450 kW and peak efficiency exceeding 99.3%. According to onsemi analysis, the 0.4% improvement could save more than 475 MWh of energy annually in a 100 MW BESS installation compared with the previous-generation module. The design win builds on a long-standing strategic relationship; the companies collaborated through platform definition, system optimization and qualification. Sergio Fissore, VP and GM, IPD Power Division: the EliteSiC hybrid power module 'enables higher-efficiency, higher-density energy storage systems'.
